provenance.sourceNote: First cross-metric coincidence rule (U12). Pairing chosen because the brain serves a verified sleep_duration_min|increases|hrv_sdnn_ms edge; the engine additionally scopes coincidence rules to brain-neighbour pairs at runtime (C10), so this rule only ever fires through that edge. Lag 1 day from the C10 lag set {0,1,3,7}: HRV is expected to respond to sleep on roughly a next-day horizon.

template.title: Recovery pattern: {{metric_b_label}} and {{metric_a_label}} rising together
template.body: Your {{metric_b_label}} data has been rising, and your {{metric_a_label}} data rose in step about {{lag_days}} day(s) behind it. Published research links these two signals, and your own recent data shows the same pattern.
